core_obligations: Compute on the site itself (proof lines 8738-8746): the cohomology of the internal hom complex is by definition the homotopy category Hom group, and because the target is a K-injective representative of M this group is the Hom group in the derived category, giving the second displayed identity.

Localise (proof lines 8747-8751): for an object U the restriction of the K-injective complex to the localisation at U remains K-injective, so the same computation applies over U and gives the first identity.
proof_roadmap: Identify the cohomology of the internal hom complex with homotopy classes of maps.
Use K-injectivity (and its localisation property) to replace homotopy classes by derived Hom.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies H^0 of the internal hom complex into a K-injective representative with Hom in the derived category, globally and over any object (statement lines 8719-8735). The proof (proof lines 8737-8751) applies the defining equation of the internal hom complex and the localisation property of K-injective complexes. H2: one identification applied twice, written out.
